A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide an approach to minimize the expected communication in a distributed Bayesian Network, and we show that this can be done with a decentralized MMDP.
we provide a framework that can help a distributed application to find a communication strategy that minimizes communication cost while reaching a desired solution quality.
we propose a new problem formulation for a distributed Bayesian network and develop two algorithms to find a near-optimal solution.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the communication cost of distributed decision making can be reduced by exploiting the problem structure and the solution quality requirements.
the expected communication cost can be reduced by 20-40% by carefully choosing the communication strategy.

, by using the decentralized MDP, we are able to find the minimum communication cost needed to reach a required solution quality, and this is useful in distributed applications where the communication cost is a concern.
